strings.en: Phew, nothing feels better than finishing a job!
You sound kinda like some old junk dealer.
Shut up, I was finally feeling good. Don't rain on my parade.
...But... to think the people of Vega had lost their own planet too...
They were just like me...
...Princess...
That was... kinda sad...
That doesn't matter! They destroyed planet after peaceful planet!
They got what they deserved!
As you sow, so shall you reap. Anyway, good work, everyone.
Captain Bright... The Vega Star Federation
fell with the deaths of King Vega, his officers, and the Royal Guard.
There may be remnants, but we needn't worry about them anymore.
Understood. ...You've finally fulfilled your long-held wish, Umon...
No, Duke Fleed.
Yes... From now on, as Daisuke Umon, I'll fight to protect my second home.
It seems you've regained your usual composure...
As one would expect of the prince of Fleed.
Going back to Fleed will have to wait a little longer, huh, Brother.
Is that okay? Aren't you worried about your planet too?
Thanks for worrying about us.
But how far Fleed has recovered from the Vegatron radiation,
we won't know until we go there...
I'm worried about Fleed too, but... while Earth is in such trouble,
we can't just go home to our own planet!
Oh? Maria, aren't you more worried about Koji
than about Earth?
Wh... wh-why does Koji's name come up here!?
Oh my? So you're still just a girl when it comes to that sort of thing, Maria.
Big Sis had a pure phase like that too, you know?
Never mind ancient history. What's next? Captain, our heading?
Ancient history!?
...Sigh. Yes, while we were recovering you all, Captain Burning contacted us.
Both the Elshank and the Nadesico have made contact with Dr. Tarsan.
Then they can come back here right away.
Yes. I'm thinking of contacting Commander Hazuki to unite all units.
All the units...? Captain, isn't that dangerous?
Knowing Captain Bright, he must have some plan in mind, though...
If the Elshank group is coming back,
then things on Mars must have settled down for now. ...Don't tell me!
...Did something happen that the forces sent to Mars couldn't handle?
...That's right...
Didn't a pretty big force go to Mars?
Interesting... Those who went to Mars: Maya's group, Banjo's crew,
Kappei and the others, the Combattler team...
Quattro, Uraki, and old man Burning too, right?
Yes. And the Nadesico crew joined them as well.
...And still there's "something" they can't handle...?
Domon, you actually remembered all that, huh.
Don't insult me, Rain. Knowing our forces is the most basic of basics.
Heh. Know yourself and your enemy, and fear not a hundred battles...
I see you've kept to my teachings, Domon.
But something even that much force can't handle...
Captain Quattro and Captain Misumaru want to meet in person too.
Fortunately, operations on the surface seem to be going well.
Commander Hazuki's unit should be up on the Moon before long.
The Moon? So the meeting point is Von Braun?
Yes. Docking every ship and servicing mobile suits and super robots...
there are few places that can do that in the whole Earth Sphere.
Won't Nina be thrilled again? "All the Gundams together!" and all that.
Earth's forces are gathering... Is it really all right for me to be here...?
Don't worry about it,
nobody on this ship minds one bit!
Right. Earth's people... at least everyone in Londo Bell,
won't turn away someone who feels the same way.
Hey, until Commander Hazuki and the others get here,
let's go hang out on the Nadesico! That ship looks fun!
Seconded! Warships are so stiff and boring, y'know?
Come on, don't get too carried away, Lamba.
...If the Dangaioh team goes, Captain Misumaru really might
fight back with costumes of her own...
......A rabbit... huh.
Huh? What is it, Kyosuke?
According to Koji and Banjo, the Nadesico even has an open-air bath.
Pretty nice, huh?
...I'll pass.
Hey, Kyosuke, did something happen on the Nadesico?
(I can't take that happening again.)
Mingling is fine, but remember it's for our coming operations.
All right, set course for Von Braun!
Bright / Play the Earth route (Gandor Team) / Play the Mars route (Nadesico Team)
